info.title: My Tiny Senpai
info.synopsis: Shinozaki è un impiegato che si prende cura della sua collega Katase Shiori, che reputa gentile e amorevole. Forse i sorrisi della donna sono solo espressione di cortesia, come pensa il giovane, ma è comunque felice di starle accanto.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Shinozaki Takuma is in his first year of employment at his new job, and is encountering a lot of the same struggles most new workers run into. But the presence of a cute, doting senpai named Katase Shiori might make the job worth it, no matter how tough it gets.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After their manager's attempt to arrange a romantic dinner for the two of them, a rainy day leaves Shinozaki feeling under the weather, and Shiori decides to check in on him.

episodes.synopsis: Shinozaki and Shiori reminisce over past experiences at work during lunch with Akina. On their way back to the office they happen upon a crane game with plushies that remind them of one another.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Chinatsu has plans to attend a cosplay event on a day off from work and doesn't want her coworkers to know. While on her way she happens to bump into her manager. Later on, Katase has a piece of chocolate for Halloween that contains alcohol.

episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 7
